I don't see a paper attached; your working directory is empty. I'm assuming you mean the ablation table (Table 5) in Radford et al., 2018, *"Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training"* (GPT-1), which includes a "Transformer w/o pre-training" row.

From memory, the averages in that table are:

| Variant | Avg. score |
|---|---|
| Transformer w/ aux LM (full) | 74.7 |
| **Transformer w/o pre-training** | **59.9** |
| Transformer w/o aux LM | **75.0** |
| LSTM w/ aux LM | 69.1 |

- **Without pre-training**, the Transformer averages **59.9**, about 15 points below the full model.
- **Highest average:** the **Transformer without the auxiliary LM objective** (75.0) slightly beats the full model (74.7). The authors note the auxiliary objective helps on larger datasets (e.g., QQP, MNLI) but not on smaller ones.

Please double-check these numbers against the PDF. If you meant a different paper, send it or tell me the title and I'll look at that table instead.
